description: Authoritative evaluation benchmark suite assessing defect detection accuracy, evidence grounding, and false positive rejection across reviewer architectures.

evaluation_protocols.leakage_prevention: Model prompts receive strictly the code under review and case title/description. Ground truth defect types, explanations, and line ranges are stored out-of-band and never exposed in prompts.
evaluation_protocols.matching_policy: Deterministic bipartite matching with 5-line proximity tolerance and category compatibility verification.
evaluation_protocols.ground_truth_authority: Dual-checked: Static analysis verification rules (Bandit/Semgrep) + unit test assertions + CVE advisory records.
